decision.reason: [ev-8ab94de966ea] is only a one-line changelog entry. It says that "compareoptions default values" were updated in a breaking way (feat!), with a pointer to PR #22230. It does not name which compare option keys changed or where they are configured, the old and new default values, which environments are exposed, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. Settling the four open aspects needs the PR or the 2.14→3.0 upgrade guide section on this change.
